candidates.change_summary: Replace `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` with `rewardsForA[recipient] = 1;` so that state is not fully cleared and subsequent reads differ.
Delete `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` so that the reward mapping is never reset, causing the stored value to remain nonzero after withdrawal.

Replace `uint amountToWithdraw = rewardsForA[recipient];` with `uint amountToWithdraw = rewardsForA[recipient] + 1;` so that withdrawn amount differs from the stored reward value, while the reward is still zeroed.
Delete the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] = true, so subsequent calls can get the bonus again.
Replace require(!claimedBonus[recipient]) with require(claimedBonus[recipient]), inverting the restriction so only already-claimed recipients get an additional bonus.
Replace rewardsForA[recipient] += 100 with rewardsForA[recipient] += 101, changing the bonus amount added.
Move claimedBonus[recipient] = true before withdrawReward, so the state variable is set to true earlier and re-entrant calls will see it as true.

Delete the nonReentrant modifier from withdrawReward call by removing the modifier from the function signature was not possible per rules, so instead delete the require(!claimedBonus[recipient]) check, but that would revert on second call anyway. Instead, remove the modifier from withdrawReward in the base (not allowed here). No applicable single-statement edit. Skip this candidate.
